entries.name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
entries.reason: Source-bound reverse step with fixed whole front-foot contact, two hanging neutral dumbbells, stacked torso and constrained22.25/22.25 leg chains. Rear foot lifts, lands on the toes, rear knee hovers, and rear foot returns to the original stance. Numeric stride/hover/tempo are schematic draft choices; front alignment view, separate technique/native runtime acceptance still required. Not a forward or walking-lunge alias.
entries.summary: Step back softly, lower with the front foot planted and drive back to standing.

frames.caption: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand and both feet on the floor.
Step the rear foot back softly; keep the whole front foot planted.
Lower with the torso stacked until the back knee hovers above the floor.
Keep the front heel down; the front leg works while the rear toes support balance.
Drive through the whole front foot to raise the body under control.
Bring the rear foot back beside the planted front foot and stand tall again.

entries.name: Elevated Back Lunge
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 18 degrees so the squat rack, the barbell across the upper back, the low platform under both feet, the step back off the platform, and the painted floor contact of each back knee at the bottom all show clearly: stepping back off the platform with one leg until the back knee reaches the floor, driving through the front foot to return to the platform, and repeating with the other leg.
entries.summary: Standing with both feet on a low platform and a barbell across the upper back, step back off the platform with one leg and lower under control until the back knee reaches the floor, then drive through the front foot to return to the platform and repeat with the other leg.

frames.caption: Take the bar from the rack across the upper back and stand with both feet on a low, stable platform.
Step back off the platform with one leg and lower under control until the back knee reaches the floor.
Drive through the front foot to return to standing with both feet on the platform, back tight and chest up.
Repeat with the other leg, stepping back off the platform and lowering until the back knee reaches the floor.
Drive through the front foot to return to the platform.

entries.name: Lunge Pass Through
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 22 degrees so the upright torso, the forward lunge with the opposite foot, and the kettlebell passing clearly under the front thigh from one hand to the other all read without occlusion: stepping forward with the opposite foot while passing the bell under the front leg to the other hand, pushing through the front heel to return to standing, then stepping forward with the other foot and passing the bell back.
entries.summary: Standing tall with a kettlebell in one hand, step forward with the opposite foot and lower the back knee toward the floor with the torso upright while passing the kettlebell under the front thigh to the other hand, push through the front heel to stand, then repeat on the other side.

frames.caption: Stand tall holding a kettlebell in one hand.
Step forward with the opposite foot and lower the back knee toward the floor with the torso upright.
Pass the kettlebell under the front thigh to the other hand.
Push through the front heel to return to standing with the kettlebell in the other hand.
Step forward with the other foot and lower the back knee toward the floor with the torso upright.
Pass the kettlebell under the front thigh back to the first hand.
Push through the front heel to return to standing tall.
